title: Rick & Sue
blurb: Just retired with a big 401(k). They disagree about what they spend.
notes:
Rick & Sue Alvarez - first meeting after retirement, 10/27
Rick 65 (engineer, retired in April), Sue 63 (nurse, retired too). Both healthy, Sue says "excellent" - runs half marathons.
Neither has claimed SS. Rick's statement shows $3,600/mo at FRA, plans to claim at 67. Sue's is $2,100, she wants to start at 64.
Rick's 401k rolled to IRA: $1.55M. Sue's 403b/IRA: $380k. Roth $90k. Brokerage $260k (basis ~$200k). Cash $80k.
House in Peoria ~$520k, paid off.

Spending: Rick says $9,000/mo. Sue jumped in: "with the travel and the cabin it's more like eleven." Need to pin this down - ask for 3 months of card statements.
Travel budget $25k/yr for the next 10 years. Cabin in Wisconsin costs about $9k/yr, they'll keep it 15 years.
Mod. aggressive allocation, they want growth. Rick's worry is a market crash right as they start. Priority is enjoying it now while healthy. Would trim some if markets fell.
Rick read an article about Roth conversions before RMDs - wants to know how much to convert and whether to do it before Medicare.
No pensions. No LTC insurance.
